lines.1: We had worked fairly late, so I was tired.
lines.2: 「Tomorrow is finally the executive committee's expedition.」
lines.4: 「It is still part of a school function.」
lines.5: 「Getting too carried away would be unwise.」
lines.7: 「One way or another, you are still a child.」
lines.9: I didn't want to hear that from someone who was already so excited she'd put on her swimsuit.
lines.10: Well, I decided not to press the point.
lines.11: 「This is a school function. A proper senior must also take good care of the junior he invited.」
lines.15: Otome was unusually excited and talking even more passionately than usual, so I escaped to the courtyard.
lines.17: A whole row of hanging corpses dangled before me.
lines.18: 「Do you not know what teru teru bozu are?」
lines.19: 「Oh... Those are weather dolls? They're way too big!」
lines.20: 「I thought this was a murder scene.」
lines.22: Someone might mistake it for a haunted house.
lines.24: She was taking this way too seriously...
lines.25: 「Do not get so excited that you catch a cold.」
lines.26: Grrr, I wanted to say it back!
lines.27: I wanted to say it back so badly!
lines.28: But it would be pointless, so I gave up.
lines.29: Apparently, this woman had never caught a cold in her life.
